# telnyx_ai_knowledge_collection_documents (Data Source)

Searches the documents of an AI knowledge collection and returns the matching chunks, best first.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The slug.

### Optional

- `filter` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `query` (String)
- `retrieval_type` (String) One of `hybrid`, `keyword`, `vector`.
- `sources` (String)
- `top_k` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `ai_knowledge_collection_documents` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ai_knowledge_collection_documents))

<a id="nestedatt--ai_knowledge_collection_documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ai_knowledge_collection_documents`

Read-Only:

- `chunk_index` (Number)
- `chunk_total` (Number)
- `id` (String)
- `ingested_at` (String)
- `metadata` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `organization_id` (String)
- `record_created_at` (String)
- `record_id` (String)
- `record_type` (String) The source record kind this chunk came from (e.g. `voice`, `meeting_bot`, `message`).
- `region` (String)
- `score` (Number) Relevance score (higher = more relevant) for ranked search. `0.0` for plain catalog listings (when `query` is omitted).
- `text` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
